title: Kitchen Dense Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A pungent and dense Tunisian stew made with lamb, gelatine leafs, and pickle, suitable for low-glycemic diets. This monsoon-inspired dish is perfect for a hearty dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the cumin, coriander, and chopped pickle, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours.
Soak the gelatine leafs in cold water for 5 minutes, then add them to the pot and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer for another 30 minutes, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
